parsed.rationale: A newly invited analyst receives an 'access denied' message after accepting the invite, while other users can log in normally—this is a workspace access/permission issue affecting onboarding of a specific user.

parsed.draft_response:
Hi there—thanks for the details. Sorry about the access issue for your newly invited analyst.

To help us get her working today, can you please reply with the following:
1) The exact text of the “access denied” message (and any error code, if shown).
2) Her email address (or username) and the workspace name/identifier she’s trying to access.
3) Whether she can log in successfully, and what she sees right after login (e.g., denied on a specific page/workspace).
4) The role/permissions you intended her to have with the invite (if you know).

Once we have that, we can check the invitation/account status and workspace permissions for her user and advise on the next steps as quickly as possible.
promised_actions: Review the invitation/account status and workspace permissions for the specified user
Advise on next steps once the requested details are provided
safety_notes: Did not promise a fix or restoration time today.
Did not claim to have identified the root cause.
Requested only the minimum useful clarifications (exact error text, user identity, workspace, and login behavior).
Did not make any security or legal determinations.

parsed.customer_impact: The new analyst cannot access the workspace, which blocks onboarding/continued operations for that user.
grounded_facts: A new analyst was invited yesterday.
After accepting the invite, the new analyst gets an 'access denied' message.
Other users can log in normally.
missing_information: The exact wording of the 'access denied' message (and any error code/log details).
Which workspace/application this applies to (name/identifier) and what the invite was for (specific role/permissions if known).
Whether the invitation was accepted successfully (e.g., account status) before the access denied occurs.
Whether the new analyst can log in at all and, if so, what happens after login (e.g., denied on a specific page/workspace).
Any recent changes to workspace permissions/roles or account provisioning around the time of the invite.
The new analyst’s identity details needed for troubleshooting (e.g., email address/username) and which account they are using.
risk_signals: Potential permission/authorization misconfiguration affecting user onboarding
Ambiguity in the error details since only 'access denied' is mentioned
parsed.summary: After accepting an invite, a newly invited analyst receives an 'access denied' message and cannot access the workspace, while other users can log in normally.
